Title: Life to Those Who Look at the Serpent
Promise: God pledged that a serpent of brass set upon a pole would bring life to everyone bitten by the fiery serpents who looked upon it.
Condition: Looking upon the serpent of brass after being bitten.
Fulfillment: Numbers 21:9 records Moses making a serpent of brass and setting it on a pole, and that everyone bitten who looked upon it lived.
